description: Asked about the glass, and said he should have kept it.
name: Alse Pinder

description: Heard it with the knife down, and called it a bad example.
name: Mistress Dorcas Ansell

description: Asked who speaks at the end, and kept it off the stair.
name: Gillis Verbeke

description: Told the whole, and said it is not out of the house.
name: William Shakespeare
